endorsements.name: Jimi Sebree
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-1977
endorsements.description: Insufficient Cross-Site Request Forgery (XSRF) protection on Expedition Migration Tool allows remote unauthenticated attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and to perform actions on the Expedition Migration Tool. This issue affects Expedition Migration Tool 1.1.51 and earlier versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
